$comment: The Fly GACA family contract. Committed byte-identically to ay2m/Office, ay2m/FlyGACA and ay2m/Captain-Adel.
Each block names the repo that OWNS it. Only the owner edits its block; the other two copies are mirrors.

To change it: edit the owning repo's copy, run Office's tools/contracts/stamp-manifest.mjs to re-stamp `sha`, bump `version`, then copy the file verbatim into the other two repos and open all three PRs together.

Each repo has a parity test that asserts its own source of truth against this file and verifies `sha` (FlyGACA: tests/family-contract.test.ts; Captain-Adel: test/family-contract.test.js; Office: tools/print/check-facts.mjs).

LIMITATION: nothing offline can prove the three copies are the same revision. `version` + `sha` reduce that to a visible one-line diff; a scheduled cross-repo workflow would be needed to close it fully.
This file carries NO banking data. company-facts.md sets a hard rule that the IBAN and account number never leave ay2m/Office.

chat.$comment: The answer contract both brains must honour. FlyGACA's server/src/contract.ts is the definition; Captain-Adel's /v1/chat is a superset (it additionally returns `suggestions`, `grounding` and a richer `meta`). Listed here so neither side can drop a field the other depends on. See ay2m/FlyGACA: docs/DESIGN-brain-consolidation.md.

repos.$comment: The real roster. Supersedes any prose claiming a `FlyGACA/…` org or per-module App Store repos — those paths are dead.

members.name: ay2m/Office
members.role: The internal documents repository — strategy, governance, legal, finance, KSA compliance, HR, ops, GTM, IR, curriculum, brand. No product code.

members.name: ay2m/FlyGACA
members.role: The product: the bilingual React 19 + Vite web app and its Express backend on Cloud Run, plus the regulatory corpus and content pipelines.

members.name: ay2m/Captain-Adel
members.role: The standalone AI flight instructor behind captadel.com. Its src/brain is the reference implementation of the retrieve → ground → cite contract.

members.name: ay2m/FlyGACA-ios
members.role: The native SwiftUI family — one shared package, one App Store app per exam module. ELPT and AIP ship; PPL, CPL, IR and ATPL are parked.

members.name: ay2m/FlyGACA-app
members.role: The retired predecessor of ay2m/FlyGACA. Read-only, kept for its 1,005-commit history. Never cite as current.
